description: This file is a Java JUnit test class for testing the ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl class, which is part of the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify immutability, equality, null handling, resource accessors, and other behaviors of the command implementation.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl class, verifying its behavior and properties.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method runs, creating instances of ModifyFeature and ModifyFeatureLiveCommand.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl is immutable and that Feature class is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods conform to their contracts using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToGetModifyFeatureLiveCommandForNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to the factory method throws NullPointerException with expected message.

methods.name: tryToGetModifyFeatureLiveCommandForCreateThingCommand
methods.description: Checks that passing a command of wrong type throws ClassCastException.

methods.name: getModifyFeatureLiveCommandReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the properties of the created command match the input twinCommand.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that setting DittoHeaders returns a new command with the specified headers.

methods.name: answerReturnsNotNull
methods.description: Ensures that the answer() method returns a non-null object.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toString() output contains class name and key command details.
